title: 第10章【冥婚】不存在的人
slug: 诡异副本勇敢者的游戏
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

在杏花河边上，远远地顾原就看到一个人，那人佝偻着身子，像是在地里挖着什么。

顾原连忙走过去，就听到呼哧呼哧的喘气声，再一看地上已经大大小小的布满了十多个深坑，看样子这人在这里已经挖了许久了。

“你好......”

顾原打了声招呼，那人似乎年纪有些大了，侧面看去脸上满是皱纹，皮肤也黝黑，面对顾原的招呼那人也没有回头，而是自顾自的挖着坑，每挖一会都要听下去看一下，似乎是在寻找什么东西。

见那人没反应，顾原伸手拍了拍那人的后背。

他的动作停了下来，可当转过头时却让顾原不自觉的后退一步，脸上的表情瞬间变得惊恐起来，就连大气都不敢喘。

但同时，顾原的脑海中也出现了那人的介绍。

【姓名：方东】

【身份：不存在的人】

除此以外，更令顾原感到恐惧的是方东的脸，他的眼眶中没有眼球，只有两个黑漆漆的洞口，流着黑色的液体。

如果不是白天，顾原看到这一幕只怕是魂都要被吓丢了。

紧接着，方东朝着自己走了过来，他的步伐很慢，但方向却丝毫不差，像是能看到顾原一样。

方东一步步靠近，顾原下意识的向后退去，他身上散发的恶臭味扑鼻而来，那种味道就像是在地下埋了无数年却只腐烂而没有消失的尸体。

方东的鼻子一抽一抽，像是在闻什么东西一样，紧接着他的嘴张开了。

而嘴张开的一瞬间，那些黑色的腥臭的液体就顺着嘴流了出来，滴到地上发出噗噗的声音。

“清......”

方东的口中缓缓吐出一个字，他的五官扭曲，看上去没说出一个字都非常艰难。

顾原并没有听清楚他说的什么字，他的手中紧紧握着铜钱剑，只要这怪物再敢靠近一步，他绝对会毫不犹豫的朝着他刺过去，即使他是真的玩家。

方东两只空荡荡的眼眶死死的盯着顾原，伸出一只手指向顾原的怀中。

“清......”

这一次，顾原听到了方东的声音，而且根据方东手指的方向来看，他指的是自己怀里，可是自己的怀里......

顾原摸了摸自己的怀中，那里只有一个东西，那就是那双绣花鞋。

Page (1/3)

By the Xinghua River, Gu Yuan saw a man from a distance. The man was hunched over, as if he was digging something in the ground.

Gu Yuan hurriedly walked over and heard the sound of huffing and puffing. Then he saw that the ground was already covered with more than ten deep holes, large and small. It seemed that this man had been digging here for a long time.

"Hello..."

Gu Yuan said hello. The man seemed to be a little older. His face was full of wrinkles and his skin was dark when viewed from the side. When faced with Gu Yuan's greeting, the man did not look back. Instead, he dug a hole by himself, listening and looking every time he dug, as if he was looking for something.

Seeing that the man didn't respond, Gu Yuan reached out and patted the man on the back.

His movement stopped, but when he turned his head, Gu Yuan unconsciously took a step back. The expression on his face instantly became frightened, and he didn't even dare to breathe.

But at the same time, the introduction of that person also appeared in Gu Yuan's mind.

[Name: Fang Dong]

[Identity: non-existent person]

In addition, what frightened Gu Yuan even more was Fang Dong's face. There were no eyeballs in his eye sockets, only two dark holes with black liquid flowing out.

If it hadn't been during the day, Gu Yuan would have been frightened out of his wits when he saw this scene.

Immediately afterwards, Fang Dong walked towards him. His pace was very slow, but his direction was not wrong at all, as if he could see Gu Yuan.

Fang Dong approached step by step, and Gu Yuan subconsciously stepped back. The stench from his body assaulted his nostrils. The smell was like a corpse that had been buried underground for countless years but had only rotted but not disappeared.

Fang Dong's nose twitched, as if he was smelling something, and then his mouth opened.

The moment he opened his mouth, the black fishy liquid flowed out from his mouth and dropped to the ground with a popping sound.

"Qing..."

Fang Dong slowly uttered a word in his mouth. His facial features were distorted, and it seemed that it was very difficult for him not to say a word.

Gu Yuan didn't hear what he said clearly. He held the copper coin sword tightly in his hand. As long as the monster dared to take another step closer, he would definitely stab him without hesitation, even if he was a real player.

Fang Dong stared at Gu Yuan with his empty eyes, and stretched out a hand to point to Gu Yuan's arms.

"Qing..."

This time, Gu Yuan heard Fang Dong's voice, and judging from the direction of Fang Dong's finger, he was pointing to his arms, but his arms...

Gu Yuan touched his arms and there was only one thing there, the pair of embroidered shoes.
